Container.Name: bambu-controller
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted web app to monitor and control Bambu Lab 3D printers in LAN Only Mode - no cloud, no account.
Live camera (A1/P1 JPEG, X1/H2/P2S RTSPS), print job control, temperatures, fans, lights, motion, AMS, HMS alerts, SD card browser with timelapse player, G-code console, multi-user login and a security audit log.
Before the first start: 1. Set APP_SECRET to a long random string (e.g. openssl rand -base64 32). It encrypts the printers' access codes; keep a copy, the database can't be decrypted without it. 2. The container runs as nobody:users (99:100). If the appdata folder already exists with another owner, run: chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/bambu-controller
On each printer enable LAN Only Mode (and Developer Mode on recent firmware); on X1-series printers also enable LAN Mode Liveview. Then open the web UI, create the first account and add the printers (they are discovered automatically).
Container.Requires: Bambu Lab printer(s) on the same network, in LAN Only Mode.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database (accounts, printers, audit log). Must be writable by nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: APP_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. Encrypts the printers' access codes at rest (16+ characters, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -base64 32). Keep a copy: changing or losing it makes the stored access codes unreadable (re-enter them in each printer's settings).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on (host networking: change it here if 8080 is already used, then open http://[server]:[port]).

Config.Name: Secure cookies (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Set to true when the UI is reached over HTTPS through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik...). Enables Secure cookies and HSTS.

Config.Name: Trust reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true behind a reverse proxy so rate limiting and the audit log see the real client IPs.

Config.Name: Session idle timeout (hours)
Config.Description: Sign out sessions unused for this long.

Config.Name: Allow printers outside the LAN
Config.Description: Printer addresses are restricted to private/LAN ranges. Set to true only if printers are reached through public addresses (e.g. a routed VPN).

Config.Name: Push notification contact
Config.Description: Contact sent to browser push services with notifications: mailto:you@example.com or an https URL (default: the project URL). Notifications need HTTPS and outbound internet access.

Config.Name: Audit log retention (days)
Config.Description: How long security events are kept (Settings - Security log).
